question: Does the complete fixed-two-served-station integer inventory block, with only exact prefix-load pruning, give a physically verified strict decrease in original F on the same three R93 witnesses, and at what full cost?

mechanism.station_pairs: all currently served distinct station pairs a<b in ascending station index
mechanism.rectangle: every integer final inventory u in [0,C_a] and v in [0,C_b], except the unchanged pair
mechanism.load_domain: derive exact original-prefix 10/01/11 integer bands; omit only provably load-infeasible rectangle points; record all bands, interval lengths and omitted counts
mechanism.candidate_routes: preserve original vehicle assignment and relative visit order; derive signed operations from initial-u/initial-v and delete zero-operation stops
mechanism.validation: original C++ verifySolution/computeObjectiveParts for every load-surviving point, including station bounds, all load prefixes, nonmetric travel, pickup/drop and return-load handling and unchanged T+1e-7 tolerance; integer-domain failure is unknown, never exhaustion
mechanism.acceptance: only original-Evaluator physically valid candidates with binary64 F_old-F_new>1e-12; choose lowest F with deterministic (a,b,u,v) tie-break after a complete scan
mechanism.iteration: accept one complete-scan best strict improvement; rescan the entire changed served-station block until a full pass has no strict improvement
mechanism.scope: isolated offline mechanism diagnostic, not integrated R76/R83 closure or a complete ENS-C run
forbidden: historical optimal value or UB injection
extra radius, slope or step size

execution.timeout: unknown with committed partial evidence and paid cost; no resume or extension
execution.stopping: identity/correctness/resource failure stops batch and preserves paid prefix; a complete negative case does not add cases or seeds
execution.driver_bind_rule: Root must bind final source and binary hashes and reviewed G1 gate before any case launch; this manifest does not invent them
execution.run_requires: independent source/proof review, independent rational micro oracle, original-Evaluator G1 qualification, input/witness hash recheck, exclusive compute slot and explicit root run lease

cases.source: Round88 A1 startup-only ENS-C final result; fixed A2 D6 witness
cases.historical_evidence: runner_a1_startup_d6/raw/01_D6_ENS-C/audit.json neutral_closure.passed=true and result.exhausted=true, optimizer_calls=0; result.json verification original feasible/recomputed; fresh diagnostic still revalidates

cases.source: Round88 G3 ENS-C first same-run verified startup witness; fixed A2 E8 witness
cases.historical_evidence: runner_a1_g3/raw/02_E8_ENS-C/audit.json first witness source=same_run_verified_startup; neutral_exchange passed/exhausted, two equal-F relocations, zero strict moves; selected initial route is not claimed identical to later closure final route
cases.witness_stage: first verified startup witness, before equal-F neutral route changes

cases.source: Round88 G3 ENS-C first same-run verified startup witness; fixed A2 S12 witness
cases.historical_evidence: runner_a1_g3/raw/05_S12_ENS-C/audit.json first witness source=same_run_verified_startup; neutral_exchange passed/exhausted with zero neutral or strict moves; fresh diagnostic still revalidates
cases.witness_stage: first verified startup witness, old neutral closure made no move

required_case_evidence: pre/post source and binary hashes; input and witness hashes
baseline and final original-Evaluator route, inventory, physical flags and F/G/P
each pair capacity rectangle, all prefix bands, each u interval and excluded/retained count
each retained (a,b,u,v) result/reject reason and original F/G/P where valid
complete pass counts, accepted choices and rescans, exhaustion/deadline/error distinction
whole process launch-to-exit wall, child/process-tree status and all paid failed prefixes
interpretation: Positive fixed-witness original-F descent is mechanism evidence only; a complete no-improvement result applies only to this fixed-inventory block of the fixed witness. Timeouts/representation failures are unknown. No result implies full ENS-C acceleration, global certificate, or current-candidate held-out confirmation.
